summary: Warsh's first FOMC delivered a hawkish dot-plot shock: rates held at 3.50-3.75% but 9 of 18 officials now project a 2026 hike (median dot 3.80%), 2yr yield +16bp to 4.21%, DXY +~1%. Clean rotation OUT of long-duration software (APP -6.93%, NOW -5.77%, META -5.44%) and precious metals (SLV -4.39%, gold -1.69%) and INTO semis/AI-power/defense (AVGO +4.30%, GEV +6.77%, HOOD +8.78%). VIX +12.37% to 18.44; SPX Adv/Dec 71/428; SPX & NDX trends rolled to Down. Iran deal faded to 'rearview mirror', oil flat. Worst Fed-day SPX session for a new chair since 1994.
